# Security Policy & Responsible Disclosure

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.0.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0   | :x:                |

## 🔐 Reporting a Vulnerability

We take the security and integrity of our codebase, 3D simulation pipeline, and user projects seriously. If you have discovered a security vulnerability, we appreciate your cooperation in disclosing it to us responsibly.

### 📧 Official Security Contact
- **Security & Vulnerability Reports**: [agusdwirianto@gmail.com](mailto:agusdwirianto@gmail.com)
- **Founder & Maintainer**: Agus Dwi Rianto (AUDIRA)
- **Organization**: Audira Multimedia Digital / Audira Sukses Mandiri
- **Official Domain**: [https://audira.my.id](https://audira.my.id)
- **Hotline / WhatsApp**: [+62 821-1200-1600](https://wa.me/6282112001600)

### What to Include in Your Report
When reporting a vulnerability, please provide:
1. A clear description of the vulnerability and its potential impact.
2. Step-by-step reproduction instructions or Proof of Concept (PoC) scripts where applicable.
3. Affected components (e.g., WebGL scene parsing, JSON schema sanitization, API routes).
4. **Important**: Do not include passwords, API keys, or sensitive personal credentials.

### What to Expect
- **Initial Response**: We aim to acknowledge receipt of vulnerability reports within 24–48 hours.
- **Triage & Remediation**: We will review and triage the issue, then work on a patch or mitigation.
- **Public Disclosure**: Please allow us reasonable time to address the issue before any public disclosure.
